cases.instructions: Answer from the policy snapshot only. Use exactly three lines beginning Eligibility:, Owner step:, and Link lifetime:. Explain policy; do not perform account actions. Retain all three lines even for a question focused on one policy detail.
cases.evidence: VellumNest policy snapshot dated 2032-04-12: Maple-7 is on the Studio plan. A workspace owner can request a ZIP archive of an archived notebook from Settings > Archives. Editors can view archived notebooks but cannot request ZIP archives. Studio includes archive export at no charge. A completed export link expires 48 hours after generation. The notebook called Fern Ledger is archived in Maple-7; its requester currently has the editor role. An owner can request the archive directly; changing the editor role is not required. This snapshot describes eligibility and contains no generated export link.
cases.answer:
Eligibility: You cannot request the ZIP as an editor; Studio includes the export at no charge for an owner.
Owner step: A Maple-7 owner must request Fern Ledger from Settings > Archives; your role need not change.
Link lifetime: A generated download link lasts 48 hours.
